messages:
maria: Drafting the RN + internal announce for tomorrow's 2.8.3 deploy (10:00 PT). Need: pin list, rollback owners, cutoff, and a concise BLUF for the staff blast. Draft below — please inline edits.

deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled canary for 10:00 PT -> full rollout 10:30 PT. Canary target: staging->prod.

sam: +1 on BLUF. We should call out KV-cache fix and the embedding quant tweak. Pin runtime v2.1.4.

hiro: Oncall: @oncall-frontend for first 1hr, @oncall-infra standby. Rollback owner: @leo_infra.

anne-product: Draft BLUF suggestion: "Patch release 2.8.3: fixes intermittent LV cache stall and improves embedding quality; no user-facing changes expected. Ops-ready: monitor latency and error rate for 60m."

leo_infra: Confirm rollback plan: revert pin to v2.1.3, flush prefix cache, and block new batch jobs. ETA 5-7m to revert.

maria: good, add cutoff: 09:30 PT for feature flags and long-running jobs.

devops: please run this snippet before canary: 
```
# drain batch workers
kubectl scale deploy/batch-workers --replicas=0 -n inference
# notify queue
curl -X POST https://internal/notify -d '{"msg":"drain starting"}'
```

sam: Minor copy tweak: change 'no user-facing changes' -> 'no expected user-facing changes'.

maria: updated below – final RN/internal blurb:

```
BLUF: Patch release 2.8.3 (10:00 PT) — fixes KV prefix caching stall and an embedding quantization edge-case. No expected user-facing changes. Canary at 10:00 PT, full rollout ~10:30 PT.
Ops notes: Pin runtime: v2.1.4. Rollback: revert to v2.1.3 (owner: @leo_infra). Cutoff for long jobs/flags: 09:30 PT. Oncall: @oncall-frontend (00:00-01:00 post-deploy), @oncall-infra standby.
Runbook snippet: drain batch workers, monitor latency (p50/p95), and watch deploybot heartbeats. If errors > 2% for 5min -> rollback.
```

anne-product: LGTM :thumbsup: Please add to internal digest and pin the RN to ops channel.

maria: will push to #eng-releases and ping standby. tagging @deployops for deploybot notes.

deployops: queued deploy instructions noted. Will trigger canary at 10:00 PT and post status.

maria: thanks everyone — I'll send the internal blast at 09:40 PT and post final pin. :sparkles:
